what_happened: the cell had trained and been evaluated, but its delivery had not been accepted when the governed transport failed. Recovery used `df_sota_repro.py report` (not `execute`, which would have retrained an existing cell). That invocation rebuilt the terminal's work timestamps from the moment of reporting, and an older pending envelope returned a generation conflict

as_currently_recorded.status: RECONSTRUCTED_AT_RECOVERY: these are the reporting moment, not the measured work window

as_measured.source: the terminal retained before the recovery invocation, preserved beside the current one

corroboration.note: the cell record's own timestamp lies inside the measured window

unaffected.reading: accepted metrics and artifact identity are evidence about the measurement; they are NOT evidence that a newly reported work-start timestamp is true. Only the two timestamps above are corrected, and only by this additive record

preserved.conflicting_envelope: preserved as delivered; not erased and not replayed
preserved.warehouse_history: NOT rewritten by this correction: this record is additive and local to the campaign root
